div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gates that exist in the schema but are never enforced:
article_article.publish_at / expire_at and recruit_recruit.deadline are stored and
returned, yet no queryset filters on them — an expired post stays public until
a human flips active. Only /member/logined/getOne carries an owner-or-staff check;
full-PII reads elsewhere are staff-only endpoints.
